description: This file contains implementation of functions for generating and managing XML test summaries related to the 'clar' testing framework. It handles opening files, writing test suite and test case results, failures, and finalizing the report.

methods.name: int clar_summary_close_tag(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * tag,int indent)
methods.description: Writes an end tag for XML elements with proper indentation.

methods.name: int clar_summary_testsuites(struct clar_summary * summary)
methods.description: Starts the <testsuites> section in the XML report.

methods.name: int clar_summary_testsuite(struct clar_summary * summary,int idn,const char * name,time_t timestamp,int test_count,int fail_count,int error_count)
methods.description: Creates a <testsuite> element with metadata such as name, timestamp, and counts.

methods.name: int clar_summary_testcase(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * name,const char * classname,double elapsed)
methods.description: Creates a <testcase> element with name, classname, and elapsed time.

methods.name: int clar_summary_failure(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * type,const char * message,const char * desc)
methods.description: Logs a failure in a test case with type, message, and description.

methods.name: int clar_summary_skipped(struct clar_summary * summary)
methods.description: Marks a test case as skipped.

methods.name: struct:clar_summary * clar_summary_init(const char * filename)
methods.description: Initializes the summary report, opens the output file, and allocates memory.

methods.name: int clar_summary_shutdown(struct clar_summary * summary)
methods.description: Finalizes the report, writes closing tags, and frees resources.

ctags.name: clar_summary_failure
ctags.signature: (struct clar_summary * summary,const char * type,const char * message,const char * desc)

ctags.name: clar_summary_testcase
ctags.signature: (struct clar_summary * summary,const char * name,const char * classname,double elapsed)

ctags.name: clar_summary_testsuite
ctags.signature: (struct clar_summary * summary,int idn,const char * name,time_t timestamp,int test_count,int fail_count,int error_count)
